claim.name: velocity-skew-follow
claim.label: Chase Speed
claim.description: The card chases the cursor with Cuberto swagger — leaning and skewing into its own velocity, easing out long like an expo tween.

claim.name: magnetic-stick
claim.label: Capture radius
claim.description: Drift close and the card snaps onto the cursor like a magnet finding steel — sticking while held near, releasing with a wobbling snap-back past the escape radius.

claim.name: spring-chain-follow
claim.label: Chain Stiffness
claim.description: The card leads a spring-linked chain — two ghost echoes whipping and overshooting behind it as the cursor drags the head around.

claim.name: gravity-well
claim.label: Gravity
claim.description: The cursor bends space — the card slides down the well’s curve toward it, stretching tidally as it nears, orbital dust streaming past into the drain.

claim.name: pendant-dangle
claim.label: Chain Length
claim.description: The card hangs from an unseen chain and dangles toward the cursor, swinging on its pivot and settling with the lazy physics of a pendant in a jeweler’s hand.

claim.name: throw-physics
claim.label: Throw power
claim.description: Grab the card with the cursor and throw it — it sails on real ballistics, bounces off the frame walls, and glides home ashamed.

claim.name: charge-release
claim.label: Charge rate
claim.description: Hold the cursor close and the card charges — compressing, trembling, edges heating brass — break away and it releases, springing tall with a crack of light.

claim.name: pointer-cast-shadow
claim.label: Shadow length
claim.description: The cursor becomes the room lamp — the card throws a soft true shadow away from it, raking long when the light is low and snapping tight underfoot when it hovers above.
